Thank you for your feedback! We are happy you find the build quality to be excellent! We apologize for the trouble you've had so far with the heat. That's not what we expect!

It sounds like your grill may be in a safety mode known as “bypass." What’s happening is that the regulator thinks there’s a gas leak, so it reduces the pressure. 

Perform a soapy water leak test to check for leaks. If there is no leak, follow these instructions to reset the bypass safety mode. This is not only the reset, but how you want to light your grill each and every time.

Open the lid
Make sure all knobs are in the off position
Turn your LP tank on all the way
Wait 60 seconds
Turn the first burner to start/high
Hit your igniter
Turn on remaining burners one at a time and set each to high
Close the lid
Let your grill preheat to 450°F

Our Specialist team is here to help. Please look for our email outreach soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Not worth the price.  The construction of the grill is not well thought out.  There are too many openings for water and other debris to collect. Most annoying is the pan that catches the drippings from the grill, it's completely open to the elements and gets filled up with rain water very quickly, overflows onto the bottom of the grill, making a greasy watery mess.  Also, the bolt that's supposed to hold the tank in place is not a good design either, it does not hold the tank securely at all.  Finally, the grill starter did not work as well as I hoped, but eventually it does light the grill, but the burners make noises as if the feed to the flame is not consistent.  If I paid half the price I would still be disappointed but I would reason it was expected for the lower price, not something at the $500 price I paid.
Results.Title: Not recommended

Results.ReviewText: We purchased this grill to replace a 20 year old Weber Genesis Silver Gas Grill that we left behind when moving.  Assembly was a not difficult but somewhat time consuming as the recommend app used for assembly does not support this particular model grill. This grill has a semi enclosed cabinet which houses a standard LP Tank.  The cabinet has left & right side panels and a front door and no rear panel which is somewhat disappointing as you really can't use it as storage. However, the bigger problem is that when its windy the grill is difficult light and if you are trying to grill at a low temp, the flame gets blown out.b   Since we just purchased this grill we have only used it a few times but it seems to do an excellent job so far.

Results.ReviewText:
Unfortunately, my experience with this Weber grill has been highly disappointing. The materials used feel cheaper than expected, and the lid and grill box arrived defective/damaged. Every time the lid is opened or closed, it produces an irritating clunking noise that is already causing ware to the outside edge of the grill box.
Adding to the frustration, working with Weber Customer Service has been a challenging ordeal. Initially, I spoke with an agent who assured me she would resolve the issue but then transferred my claim to another department that “only communicates via email”.
2 days after talking to the first agent, I got an email from the “Spirit Team Specialist” requesting my shipping address (Despite providing my shipping address through warranty registration). In his email states “apologize for the damage - I’d be glad to assist you - please confirm your shipping address – we hope your issue has been resolved; though I had no clarity on what had been resolved or what was being shipped.
Attempts to follow up by phone resulted in more runaround with another agent explaining that the matter was being handled by a specialist who could only be reached via email—a method that promised no response for 24-48 hours. Eventually, the “Spirit Team Specialist” called to offer a free accessory for the inconvenience and promised to send a new grill box and lid while attempting to find someone to replace the damaged parts. However, they warned that scheduling this technician might take 24-48 hours, followed by an additional 4-5 business days for them to arrive.
When I expressed dissatisfaction with this offer, the specialist consulted with his manager and proposed shipping a brand-new grill. However, this option required self-assembly as Weber would not honor assembly by Ace Hardware (which had assembled the original grill). When I declined this, the specialist said they would “get back to me,” but I’m still waiting after more than 24 hours.
At this point, I regret my purchase and wish I had opted for a less expensive $100 throw a way grill!
Results.Title: Definitely not the Weber quality that I’m accustom

Results.ReviewText: Have the Spirit E-325.  This is my first new grill in 35 years, it was time.  Thoughts:  New grill covers are not a durable, and flimsy, quite certain it will not last 30 years.  The grill only has two wheels instead of four making it difficult to move around on a small balcony. The propane tank is difficult to get into the shortage cabinet underneath the grill area.  The utensil holders on the side are bad as the utensils fall off when u are removing the cover. The ignition and lighting the grill is different but OK. Heating is different something you need to learn all over again. Have not had to empty the grease collection container but that may prove cumbersome. But aside from all these things,  I would still buy a Weber.
